βέλτερόν: βέλτερος — better; comparative of ἀγαθός, epic (= Attic βελτίων); neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’better (it is)’
δάσωνται: δατέομαι — divide among themselves, share out; aor. subj. mid. 3 pl., with κε in a protasis after εἰ (Attic ἐάν): ’if they share out’
δαιδαλέοισι: δαιδάλεος — skilfully wrought, cunningly made; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
δαμάσσῃ: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic δαμάσῃ), in a fear clause after μή: ’lest it overpower’
θερέω: θέρομαι — warm oneself, grow warm; aor. subj. pass. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (contracted θερῶ; prose has θερμαίνομαι), in a temporal clause with κε: ’when I am warmed’
καλέσσω: καλέω — call, summon; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic καλέσω), in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that I may summon’
καστορνῦσα: καταστορέννυμι (cf. στόρνυμι) — spread over, strew; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic, κατά shortened to κα- before στ-: ’spreading (fleeces)’
κλαυθμοῦ: κλαυθμός — weeping, wailing; masc. gen. sg.
κλισμοῖσι: κλισμός — reclining chair, seat; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
κραιπνὰ: κραιπνός — swift, rushing; neut. acc. pl. used as an adverb: ’at a rush, swiftly’
κτείναντες: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having killed’
κύνεον: κυνέω — kiss; impf. 3 pl., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἐκύνουν): ’were kissing’
κώεα: κῶας — fleece, sheepskin; neut. acc. pl. κώεα, epic uncontracted (the sg. is κῶας; prose says κῴδιον)
λέπτ: λεπτός — fine, thin, delicate; neut. acc. pl., elided (λέπτ’ = λεπτά)
μενεαίνω: μενεαίνω — be eager, be set on, be furious; pres. 1 sg., epic, with inf.: ’am eager (to)’
μηνίει: μηνίω — be angry, bear a grudge; pres. 3 sg., in a concessive εἴ περ clause
ναιετάοντας: ναιετάω — dwell, be inhabited; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (contracted ναιετῶντας; prose says οἰκέω): ’inhabited’
πήχεε: πῆχυς — forearm, arm; masc. acc. dual, epic -εε (= Attic πήχει)
παλάμηφιν: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. dat. sg. with epic suffix -φιν (= Attic παλάμῃ)
πατρώϊοι: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, paternal; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic πατρῷοι)
πείραι: Πείραιος — Peiraeus, Telemachus’s companion; masc. voc. sg., elided (Πείραι’ = Πείραιε)
πιθέσθαι: πείθομαι — obey, trust (+ dat.); aor. inf. mid. (2nd aor. ἐπιθόμην): ’to obey’
προβιβάς: προβιβάω (προβίβημι) — stride forward, step on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic προβαίνων)
προὔπεμψα: προπέμπω — send forward, send ahead; aor. 1 sg., with crasis προ-ἔπεμψα (προὔπεμψα)
πτωχεύειν: πτωχεύω — beg, live as a beggar; pres. inf.
πτωχεύῃ: πτωχεύω — beg, live as a beggar; pres. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ὄφρ’ ἄν: ’so that he may beg’
σημάντορι: σημάντωρ — overseer, one who gives orders; masc. dat. sg.
στρωφῶσα: στρωφάω — turn, twirl (the spindle); pres. part. fem. nom. sg., contracted (= Attic στρέφουσα)
στυγεροῖο: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
τελέσσῃ: τελέω — accomplish, fulfil; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic τελέσῃ), with κε in a protasis after αἴ: ’if … should accomplish’
τούτοισι: οὗτος — this, that; demonstrative pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic τούτοις): ’for these men’
τράπετ: τρέπω — turn; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, elided and unaugmented (τράπετ’ = ἐτράπετο): ’turned (away)’
φυγόντι: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. part. masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’having escaped’
φυτεύσω: φυτεύω — plant, sow; contrive; aor. subj. 1 sg. (or fut. indic.), with κε in a protasis after εἰ: ’if I plant (evil)’
χαίροντι: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’(to me) rejoicing’
ἀγαπαζόμεναι: ἀγαπάζομαι — welcome gladly, greet fondly; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl., epic (cf. Attic ἀσπάζομαι)
ἀγορεύοντες: ἀγορεύω — speak, say; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’speaking’
ἀλέη: ἀλέη — warmth, heat; fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἀλέα)
ἀλεύατο: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἠλεύατο): ’avoided’
ἀρήρει: ἀραρίσκω — fit, fit together; plpf. 3 sg. with intransitive impf. sense, epic: ’was fitted’
ἄντιτα: ἄντιτος — of requital, requiting (built on ἀντί ’in return’ and the root of τίνω ’pay’; the exact sense is uncertain); neut. acc. pl., in ἄντιτα ἔργα ’deeds of requital’
ἄπτερος: ἄπτερος — wingless; masc. nom. sg., predicate with μῦθος: ’wingless (word)’
ἄττ: ἄττα — father; respectful address to an older man (not a kinsman); masc. voc. sg., elided (ἄττ’ = ἄττα)
ἐκεῖθι: ἐκεῖ — there, in that place; adv., epic by-form ἐκεῖθι (= Attic ἐκεῖ)
ἐξερέεινον: ἐξερεείνω — question closely, ask about; impf. 3 pl., epic, unaugmented (cf. Attic ἐξερωτάω)
ἐπαυρέμεν: ἐπαυρίσκω — get a share of, enjoy (+ gen. or acc.); aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐπαυρεῖν)
ἐπιτέλλω: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, give charge to; pres. 1 sg.: ’I give charge’
ἐπιτειλαμένῳ: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, give charge to; aor. part. mid. masc. dat. sg.: ’having given charge’
ἐρύκεσθαι: ἐρύκω — hold back, keep off; pres. inf. pass.: ’to be held back’
ἐϋξέστας: ἐΰξεστος — well-polished, finely planed; fem. acc. pl., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὔξεστος)
ἔσθλ: ἐσθλός — good, noble; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἔσθλ’ = ἐσθλά): ’good things’
ἔχοντά: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’having’; with ἄλγεα, ’beset by (pains)’
ἕκαθεν: ἑκάς (ἕκαθεν) — far off, from afar; adv., epic -θεν (= Attic πόρρωθεν)
ἰκέλη: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὁμοία, ἐοικυῖα)
ὄρινε: ὀρίνω — stir up, rouse; pres. imper. 2 sg., after μηδέ in a prohibition: ’do not stir up’
ὄρνυθι: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; pres. imper. 2 sg., after μή in a prohibition: ’do not rouse’
ὄτρυνον: ὀτρύνω — urge on, send speedily; aor. imper. 2 sg. · also impf. 1 sg. or 3 pl. (same -ον ending), unaugmented
ὑπηοίη: ὑπηοῖος — at dawn, of early morning; fem. nom. sg., epic -ίη (Ionic η for α; cf. Attic ἑῷος)
ὥστ: ὥστε — so as to, so that; conj. introducing a result, + inf. (ὥστ’ … πιθέσθαι); elided (ὥστ’ = ὥστε), as in Attic

__broaden__.ἴδηται: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., in a generalizing temporal clause: ’when he looks (them) over’ · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg. after πρίν γε, ’until’: ’until she has seen (me)’ (πρίν γ’ αὐτόν με ἴδηται)
__broaden__.ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic με (ὥς με κελεύεις ’as you bid me’) · also postpositive after its noun, comparative ’like’ (οἰωνῶν ὥς ’like birds’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τοι (ὥς τοι ἐγὼν ἐρέω ’as I shall tell you’) · also correlative ’so’ answering ὅπως, introducing a wish with the opt., accented before the enclitic τοι: ’so may’ (ὥς τοι Ζεὺς τελέσειεν ’so may Zeus fulfil it for you’) · also with a plain subj. (no κε/ἄν), purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς τοι δῶρ’ ἀποπέμψω ’so that I may send you the gifts’)
__broaden__.ἀνέχεσθαι: ἀνέχω — hold up; mid. endure, put up with; pres. inf. mid., used as an imperative: ’endure’ · also pres. inf. mid. dependent on impersonal ἔστιν: ’(not) possible to put up with’ (οὔ πως ἔστιν … ἀνέχεσθαι)
__broaden__.ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in order that, how; + subj. or fut. indic. · also + opt., in secondary sequence after a past-tense verb, indirect deliberative: ’how it might’ (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also ’when’ = ὅτε · also ’as, however’ + subj. in a general clause: ὅπως ἐθέλῃσιν ’however he wishes’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might follow’ (ὅπως … ἑποίατο) · also + pres. indic., ’as, in whatever way’ (ὅπως ἐθέλεις ’as you wish’) · also ’how’ + aor. indic., indirect question after a verb of telling (κατάλεξον ὅπως ἤντησας ’tell how you came upon’)
__broaden__.ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ) · also introducing the first alternative of a question: ’whether’ (ἠὲ διεπράθετο … ἦ … ’whether it was sacked … or …’) · also ’than’, after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖος … ἠὲ πάροιθεν ’different than before’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or word of preference (βέλτερόν ἐστι … ἠὲ ’it is better … than’)
__broaden__.ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative: μεῖζον … ἤ ’greater than’ · also ’than’, ’rather than’, after a verb of preferring (βούλομ’ … ἤ τινα ’I prefer … to any’)
__broaden__.ἐμεῦ: ἐγώ — I; gen. sg., epic (= Attic ἐμοῦ): ’from me’ · also gen. as object of a verb of remembering: μνήσῃ ἐμεῦ ’you may remember me’ · also gen. with ἀέκητι: ’(against) my (will)’ (ἐμεῦ ἀέκητι)
__broaden__.αἰνῶς: αἰνῶς — terribly, exceedingly (of an uncanny likeness); adv. · also general intensifier with a verb of emotion: αἰνῶς ἵεται ’is terribly eager’ · also modifying a verb of appearing: ’terribly, fearsomely’ (διεφαίνετο δ’ αἰνῶς ’glowed terribly’) · also intensifying a predicate adjective: ’terribly, wretchedly’ (αἰνῶς … εἵματ’ ἔχω κακά ’the clothes I have are terribly bad’)
__broaden__.ἀποπέμψω: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off, dismiss; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will send away’ · also aor. subj. 1 sg., in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that I may send off’ (ὥς τοι δῶρ’ ἀποπέμψω)
__broaden__.ὄψεται: ὁράω — see; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will see’ · also in a purpose clause after ὄφρα, possibly a short-vowel subjunctive (= ὄψηται): ’may see’ (ὄφρα με μήτηρ ὄψεται)
